data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the lamp state. 0 = never: the state is only read at startup and after commands from Home Assistant, changes made on the lamp or in the app then show up later. Every read briefly connects to the lamp, and the LightUp app cannot connect during that time.
